statement: For every integer w ≥ 2 there is a finite constant C(w) ≥ 1 with the following property. Suppose a symmetric Markov flow graph has at most w states per layer, first layer {s0, s1}, and last layer {t0, t1}, and its involutions interchange the two states in each endpoint layer. Every capacity-respecting flow from s0 to t1 has value at most C(w) Pr[X0 = s0, Xr = t1]. The constant is independent of the number of layers and of all transition probabilities.
